basic_details.job_title: AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Emergency Medicine, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, is filling a Project Nurse -III post for a period of 5 months under an ICMR-funded implementation research project on emergency airway management and cardiac arrest care. The pay is INR 28,000 + 30% HRA as admissible, the essential qualification is B.Sc. Nursing, and candidates must be below 35 years on the date of interview. Indian citizens can apply by email to [email protected] by 3rd December 2026 till 5 PM.

important_dates.interview_date: Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email

how_to_apply: The application is sent by email only. The notice gives these instructions:
Prepare the application along with a detailed CV and supporting documents.
Put all documents together in a single PDF file.
Send the PDF to the email id [email protected].
Make sure the email is sent by 3rd December 2026 till 5 PM.
The notice does not prescribe an email subject line or an application form format.
Supporting document for relevant experience in Emergency Medicine

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens. The eligibility printed for the AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse -III post is: Age limit: Below 35 Years, counted on the date of interview. Age relaxation will be as per the Government of India ICMR rules; the notice does not list the category-wise relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

rows.desirable: Experience in a relevant clinical / research setting will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Nurse -III will receive INR 28,000 plus 30% HRA as admissible. The notice does not mention any other allowance. The post is under the ICMR-funded project for a period of 5 months, and immediate joining is required of the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse -III
content_sections.text: The application is sent by email only. The notice gives these instructions: Prepare the application along with a detailed CV and supporting documents. Put all documents together in a single PDF file. Send the PDF to the email id [email protected] . Make sure the email is sent by 3rd December 2026 till 5 PM. The notice does not prescribe an email subject line or an application form format. Detailed CV Class 10th certificate Class 12th certificate B.Sc. Nursing certificate Supporting document for relevant experience in Emergency Medicine

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be shortlisted, and the shortlisted candidate will be called for interview through email. The date and time of the interview are not specified in the notice; they will be communicated by email to shortlisted candidates. Age is counted on the date of interview.
